package svc

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/Maximumsoft-Co-LTD/obs-brutal/boeng"
)

func ChargeCard(ctx context.Context, card Card, amount int) (err error) {
	ctx, op := boeng.EnterCtx(ctx, "charge_card", card)
	defer op.CloseWith(&err)
	if amount <= 0 {
		return ErrInvalidAmount
	}
	return processor.Charge(ctx, card, amount)
}
